suffix.loop: Instrumental only, no vocals. Composed to loop: steady energy from start to finish, no fade-out and no big final ending. Rich, detailed, modern production. Family-friendly adventure game score.
suffix.jingle: Instrumental only, no vocals. A short musical sting that starts immediately and ends cleanly on its final note. Rich, detailed, modern production. Family-friendly adventure game score.

tracks.name: Title Theme
tracks.where: The title screen and every menu on it
tracks.prompt: Warm, hopeful main title theme at 96 beats per minute in the spirit of a classic fairy tale fantasy role playing game score: medieval folk colors, a wooden flute, a fiddle, a lute, a harp, a gentle music box and a small string orchestra. The music travels between two hometowns. It opens on Long Island with a cozy seaside village melody on music box, flute and accordion and a hint of salt air. Then the strings swell and lift like a plane taking off, and the same melody lands in sunny Los Angeles with warm nylon guitar, a soft laid back groove and a mellow flugelhorn. In the last part both worlds join: full strings and a heroic horn carry the big singable melody about a family setting out on an adventure. Playful and affectionate with a sense of wonder, a little silly, never scary.

tracks.name: Battle
tracks.prompt: Energetic adventure battle theme at 152 beats per minute. A driving string ostinato, punchy brass stabs, crunchy electric guitar doubling a heroic playful melody, taiko-style drums and a busy rolling bass line. Exciting and fun, a little cheeky, never scary. Big hook that comes back every sixteen bars.

tracks.name: Boss Battle
tracks.prompt: Epic boss battle theme at 164 beats per minute. Pounding war drums, aggressive staccato strings, a pipe organ and a wordless choir pad, snarling low brass, fast electric guitar runs. Urgent and dramatic with a sense of towering stakes, but with a streak of adventure-comedy mischief so it stays family-friendly. Builds in waves with a huge main theme.

tracks.name: Victory
tracks.prompt: Triumphant victory fanfare, twelve seconds. Bright trumpets and French horns, sparkling glockenspiel runs, a rolling timpani, rising to a joyful full-orchestra final chord that rings out and decays. Major key, celebratory, a little silly and very proud.

tracks.name: Total Defeat
tracks.prompt: Gentle game over music, ten seconds. A slow descending phrase on solo cello over soft piano chords and a low sustained string pad, minor key, sighing and a little weary, ending on a quiet unresolved held note. Sad but tender, not frightening, like the end of a bad day before a nap.

tracks.name: Level Up
tracks.where: The level-up card after a fight
tracks.prompt: A bright level-up sting, four seconds. A quick rising glockenspiel and harp arpeggio with a sparkling bell on top, a small trumpet flourish and a warm final chord that rings and decays. Cheerful, proud, a little cheeky.

tracks.name: The Square
tracks.prompt: Sunny small-town Long Island square on a warm afternoon at 104 beats per minute. Fingerpicked acoustic guitar, a breezy flute melody, light upright bass, brushed drums with a gentle shuffle, glockenspiel sparkles and a soft accordion. Cozy, nostalgic, friendly, a hint of salt air. A memorable tune you could hum, that develops across sections instead of repeating.

tracks.name: Rivituso Row
tracks.where: Rivituso Row and the family houses
tracks.prompt: Warm family home music at 88 beats per minute. Soft upright piano, a mellow clarinet, nylon guitar, brushed snare and a warm cello. Gentle swing, the feeling of a kitchen full of baked cookies and relatives talking over each other. Comforting, affectionate, unhurried.

tracks.name: Grump Hollow
tracks.prompt: Soggy swamp comedy music at 98 beats per minute. Burbling bassoon, a muted tuba, bubbling marimba, pizzicato strings and squelchy wooden percussion. Grumpy and mischievous, slightly spooky, something is always watching from the water. Wet, sticky, humorous.

tracks.name: Cattail Pier
tracks.prompt: Lazy seaside fishing pier at 80 beats per minute. Warm slide guitar, a lilting harmonica, soft ukulele, upright bass and a slow rimshot groove. Patient and sleepy with the creak of wood and slow water, and one mysterious low note now and then for the legendary fish nobody has caught.

tracks.name: Whispering Marsh
tracks.prompt: Misty marsh boardwalk at 70 beats per minute. Breathy wooden flute, kalimba, soft bowed vibraphone and airy string pads. Reeds rustling in rhythm like soft percussion, wordless whispering textures, gentle mystery, curious rather than frightening.

tracks.name: Sundial Hollow
tracks.where: Sundial Hollow and the Deep Pool
tracks.prompt: Dreamy clockwork mystery in a shifting seven-eight time at 96 beats per minute. Celesta, harp, glass harmonica, a ticking wood block, dripping water plinks and a soft low cello. A sundial that tells the wrong time: gentle off-kilter charm, deep calm water underneath.

tracks.name: Elementary Schoolyard
tracks.prompt: Playground recess energy at 122 beats per minute. A bouncy recorder melody, xylophone, hand claps, skipping-rope rhythm on snare and a bright ukulele. Cheerful and fast, with one uneasy minor-key twist in the middle because tonight is on the sign and nobody knows what that means.

tracks.name: School Hallway
tracks.prompt: Quirky empty school hallway at 108 beats per minute. Bouncy pizzicato strings, marimba, a ticking clock sound, bell tree and school-bell chimes landing slightly off the beat, a muted trombone. Every clock is wrong: playful, a little uncanny, sneaking around after hours.

tracks.name: The Cafetorium
tracks.prompt: Nervous school-band boss music at 132 beats per minute. Marching snare, blaring concert-band brass, a squealing clarinet, tuba oom-pah, timpani rolls and a frantic xylophone. Something is grading up on the stage: tense, comic, urgent, like a surprise exam set to music.

tracks.name: The Stacks
tracks.where: The Stacks under the Hush Library
tracks.prompt: Hushed underground library at 76 beats per minute. Pizzicato strings, harp, celesta, soft bowed double bass and quiet page-turn percussion. Cavernous reverb, whispering wordless voices, endless shelves, mysterious and curious, always at a whisper.

tracks.name: The Reading Room
tracks.prompt: Gothic reading room boss music at 92 beats per minute. A slow pipe organ, brooding cello, harpsichord runs and a low string tremolo, a dramatic build that never quite breaks. One very old book turning its own pages: solemn, grand, a little wry.

tracks.name: The Moon Club
tracks.prompt: Dusty velvet lounge frozen in 1971 at 84 beats per minute. Vibraphone, warm electric piano, a muted trumpet, upright bass and brushed drums. Space-age cocktail lounge jazz with a touch of melancholy and mystery, like a party that ended decades ago and the band never left.

tracks.name: The Dome
tracks.prompt: Glittering glass dome boss music at 112 beats per minute. Shimmering synth arpeggios, bright bells, a swelling orchestra, a punchy dance beat and sparkling high strings, like a mirror ball made of sound. Dazzling, almost too bright, powerful and playful.

tracks.name: Terminal Zero
tracks.prompt: Abandoned airport that closed in 1989, lights flickering back on, at 72 beats per minute. Detuned electric piano, a slow low drone, warped elevator-music chords, soft airport chime tones and distant synth pads. Lonely, eerie, retro and slightly bittersweet, a place full of old goodbyes.

tracks.name: Gate Zero
tracks.prompt: The last gate, a plane that has waited since 1989, at 100 beats per minute. Swelling strings, emotional solo piano, pulsing bass, a rising tension of anticipation and a soaring theme that sounds like departure. Epic and bittersweet, big and hopeful, the end of a long journey.

tracks.name: Downtown LA
tracks.prompt: Sun-soaked downtown Los Angeles at 108 beats per minute. Funky electric piano, a wah guitar, tight horn section, slap bass and a crisp drum groove. Glamorous movie-palace swagger, taxis and tacos, bustling and bright with a smooth city confidence.

tracks.name: Jefferson Park
tracks.prompt: Easygoing neighborhood morning at 94 beats per minute. Warm nylon guitar, a soft bossa nova groove, upright bass, light percussion, muted Rhodes chords and a gentle flugelhorn melody. Jacaranda blossoms, craftsman porches, laid back and homey, a place you are glad to come back to.

tracks.name: Griffith Park
tracks.prompt: Dusty hillside trails and bubbling tar pits at 100 beats per minute. Twangy slide guitar, hand claps, stomping kick drum, a lonely whistle and a low fiddle. Adventurous with an edge of danger, coyotes in the brush, hot sun and long shadows.

tracks.name: Studio Gate
tracks.prompt: Golden-age Hollywood studio lot at 122 beats per minute. A swinging big band with bright brass, walking bass, a lively snare and a clarinet lead, a clapperboard hit now and then. Glamorous, busy and a touch silly, with a very important snack table.

tracks.name: The Backlot
tracks.prompt: A fake Main Street, a fake Old West and a fake New York at 116 beats per minute. Ragtime piano, a saloon banjo, a jazzy clarinet and a brisk brush groove, the style flips between the three streets as you walk. Playful, theatrical, a little unreal.

tracks.name: Soundstage 7
tracks.prompt: Foggy dark soundstage catwalks at 86 beats per minute. Low bowed strings, a wavering theremin, creaking percussion, soft pulsing synth bass and a muffled music box. Suspenseful and haunted-set spooky with a wink, like a horror movie that is secretly a comedy.

tracks.name: The Stage Set
tracks.prompt: A living room that is not a living room, under forty hot lights, at 126 beats per minute. A sitcom theme turned into a thriller: stabbing strings, harpsichord, tight snare, jazzy bass and dramatic brass hits. Tense, theatrical, very sure of itself.

tracks.name: Old Oak Park
tracks.prompt: Bright community park at 110 beats per minute. Strummed ukulele, glockenspiel, a skipping marimba, handclaps, upright bass and whistled melody. Playground laughter, garden blooms and happy dogs. Joyful, light and sunny, with a tiny hint of something old and watching in the oak.

tracks.name: Inside the Old Oak
tracks.prompt: A tiny squirrel war room inside a hollow tree at 116 beats per minute. Brisk marching snare, pizzicato strings, bassoon, piccolo and a bouncy tuba. Urgent, very serious about acorns, a comic military march with warm wooden resonance.

tracks.name: The Crown of the Oak
tracks.where: The Crown of the Oak (boss room)
tracks.prompt: The very top of the old oak, a hoard and a chairman, at 102 beats per minute. Sweeping strings, majestic French horns, windswept timpani, a regal brass fanfare with a wry smile and a rushing wind texture. Grand, triumphant and comical, a villain who loves his pile.

tracks.name: Division Nine Car Barn
tracks.prompt: An old streetcar barn with rusty machinery at 90 beats per minute. Slow bluesy groove, clanking metal percussion, harmonica, a growling baritone guitar and a steady piston-like bass. Industrial, cold and echoing, one very cold turntable that might still turn.

tracks.name: The Boiler Room
tracks.prompt: A cast-iron stove that remembers every biscuit, at 106 beats per minute. Heavy brass, anvil hammer hits, crackling fire textures, rumbling bass and driving percussion with a warm hearth glow underneath. Intense and fiery but cozy at its core, menace with a baking smell.

tracks.name: Nine Scoops Party
tracks.where: Home and the Square before the hunt (Nine Scoops)
tracks.prompt: A birthday party at home at 112 beats per minute. Bouncy ukulele, handclaps, a cheerful glockenspiel melody, party horn blasts, upright bass and a skipping drum groove. Grace's ninth birthday: excited, sweet and a little chaotic, with a tune that sounds like candles about to be blown out.

tracks.name: The Scoop Hunt
tracks.where: Outside once the goal is set (Nine Scoops)
tracks.prompt: A scavenger hunt for nine missing scoops of ice cream at 124 beats per minute. Pizzicato strings, a bouncy marimba, brisk snare, a sneaky bassoon and playful clarinet runs. Determined and curious like detectives on bicycles, bright and fast with a wink, never scary.

tracks.name: The Frozen Creamery
tracks.prompt: A creamery frozen solid in ice at 84 beats per minute. Glassy celesta, a soft choir pad, sleigh bells, a slow cello and crystalline chimes with a cold shimmering reverb. Quiet and wintry, a little eerie but sweet underneath, like the inside of a freezer full of dessert.

tracks.name: Brain Freeze
tracks.where: The Brain Freeze boss fight (Nine Scoops)
tracks.prompt: Boss battle against a towering ice cream monster at 158 beats per minute. Pounding timpani, icy staccato strings, a pipe organ, brass stabs, sleigh bell accents and fast electric guitar runs. Big, dramatic and funny, a dessert that is very sure of itself. Builds in waves with a huge hook.

tracks.name: Nine Scoops Win
tracks.prompt: A sweet victory fanfare, ten seconds. Bright trumpets, a glockenspiel run, a happy birthday-style flourish on strings, a rolling timpani and a joyful final chord that rings and decays. Warm, proud and a little silly, like a cake being carried into the room.
